hints.text: Each distinct decimal digit contributes its numerical value times its appearance count.

hints.text: Summing the product of each digit and its frequency equals the total sum of all digits.

hints.text: Extract digits and calculate their cumulative sum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Extracts decimal digits and accumulates their values in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct digit extraction is already optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that sum of digit times frequency equals sum of digits.

solutions.code:
def digitFrequencyScore(n: int) -> int:
    return sum(int(c) for c in str(n))
